```{r}
library(palmerpenguins)
library(klaR)

# Select only the required columns and remove rows with NAs
penguin_data <- na.omit(penguins[, c("species", "bill_length_mm",
"bill_depth_mm", "flipper_length_mm",
"body_mass_g")])

# Convert to base data frame (not tibble!)
penguin_data <- as.data.frame(penguin_data)

# Drop unused factor levels from 'species'
penguin_data$species <- droplevels(penguin_data$species)

# Double-check everything matches
stopifnot(nrow(penguin_data) == length(penguin_data$species))

# Apply stepclass
step_result <- stepclass(species ~ ., data = penguin_data, method = "lda", direction = "both")

# Print results
print(step_result)
```

Checking structure

```{r}
library(palmerpenguins)
library(klaR)
library(tidyverse)

# Select only the required columns and remove rows with NAs
penguin_data <- na.omit(penguins[, c("species", "bill_length_mm",
"bill_depth_mm", "flipper_length_mm",
"body_mass_g")])

penguin_data %>%
  glimpse()
```
